company.status: Wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX (merger effective 14 Aug 2026)

kpis.arrNote: Bloomberg, 21 May 2026. Sacra has estimated ~$4.0B; this dashboard uses the Bloomberg figure Wikipedia cites.

arrAlt.note: Sacra estimate — not a company disclosure

headcount.note: Still cited at ~300 at merger close

releases.title: Anysphere founded
releases.detail: Michael Truell, Sualeh Asif, Aman Sanger, and Arvid Lunnemark incorporate in San Francisco while at MIT.

releases.title: Cursor editor launches
releases.detail: Public launch of the AI code editor, a VS Code fork.

releases.title: Seed · $8M · ~$100M · $1M ARR
releases.detail: Led by OpenAI Startup Fund. Angels include Nat Friedman and Arash Ferdowsi.

releases.title: Series A · $60M · $400M
releases.detail: Led by Andreessen Horowitz.

releases.title: Acquires Supermaven
releases.detail: AI code-completion startup founded by Jacob Jackson. Standalone product wound down in late 2025.

releases.title: Cursor 0.44 · Agent + Yolo Mode
releases.detail: Agent runs terminal commands, edits in parallel, and Cursor Tab expands. Yolo Mode auto-runs commands.

releases.title: Series B · $105M · $2.6B
releases.detail: Led by Thrive Capital and a16z.

releases.title: $100M ARR
releases.detail: Fifteen months from $1M ARR — among the fastest B2B SaaS ramps on record.

releases.title: Cursor 0.46 · Agent is default
releases.detail: Chat, Composer, and Agent unify. UI refresh, auto web search, MCP project servers.

releases.title: Cursor 1.0 · Bugbot · Background Agent GA
releases.detail: Automatic GitHub PR review, one-click MCP install, Jupyter support, Background Agent for all users.

releases.title: Series C · $900M · $9.9B · $500M ARR
releases.detail: Led by Thrive Capital.

releases.title: Agents on web and mobile
releases.detail: Coding agents leave the desktop IDE.

releases.title: Koala talent + Resourcely security hire
releases.detail: Enterprise-readiness team from Koala; Travis McPeak joins to lead security.

releases.title: Cursor Agent CLI
releases.detail: Agent available from the command line.

releases.title: Cursor 2.0 + Composer
releases.detail: First in-house agentic coding model. Multi-agent interface via git worktrees. Browser for Agent goes GA.

releases.title: Series D · $2.3B · $29.3B · $1B ARR
releases.detail: Co-led by Accel and Coatue. Google and NVIDIA participate.

releases.title: Acquires Graphite
releases.detail: Code-review startup. Cash-and-equity deal reported well above Graphite’s $290M valuation.

releases.title: Cloud Agents · $2B ARR · Composer 1.5
releases.detail: Async remote agents. Bloomberg reports $2B ARR.

releases.title: Cursor in JetBrains (ACP)
releases.detail: Joins Agent Communication Protocol registry; live inside JetBrains IDEs.

releases.title: Composer 2
releases.detail: Frontier-level coding model at $0.50/M input. Trained from Kimi K2.5 + RL.

releases.title: Cursor 3
releases.detail: Agent-first rebuild; Agents Window, Design Mode, /worktree and /best-of-n. No longer a VS Code fork.

releases.title: SpaceX $60B option
releases.detail: SpaceX can buy Cursor for $60B later in 2026, or pay $10B for joint work.

releases.title: Cursor SDK
releases.detail: Runtime, harness, and models that power the IDE, embeddable in other products.

releases.title: Composer 2.5 · $3B ARR
releases.detail: Long-horizon agentic gains. Bloomberg: $3B annual sales rate.

releases.title: Bugbot 90-second reviews
releases.detail: 3× faster, 22% cheaper, 10% more bugs. /review before push. Powered by Composer 2.5.

releases.title: SpaceX acquisition announced
releases.detail: All-stock merger agreement. Cursor to join SpaceXAI. Close expected Q3 2026.

releases.title: Cursor Router
releases.detail: Production-trained router: Intelligence / Balance / Cost. Powers Auto mode across desktop, web, iOS, CLI, SDK.

releases.title: Cursor Start (India)
releases.detail: ₹649/mo local plan with UPI. Grok + Composer, cloud agents, iOS.

releases.title: Cursor for iPad
releases.detail: iPad app on all paid plans. Inbox, full PR review, Apple Pencil markup.

releases.title: Google Workspace plugins
releases.detail: Agents read/write Gmail, Drive, and Calendar from Cursor.

releases.title: Cloud Agent Builds
releases.detail: Prebuilt environment snapshots. Internally 10× faster boots, 3× faster time-to-first-token.

releases.title: Merger close
releases.detail: Cursor becomes a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary. 389.3M SPCX Class A shares issued for common and preferred.

merger.structure: Reverse triangular merger: X67 Inc. (Merger Sub) merged into Anysphere; Anysphere survived as a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary.

ownershipEstimate.disclaimer: Anysphere did not publish a cap table. Employee equity of 16.2% fully diluted is derived from 8-K award conversions (vested RSUs + unvested RSUs + options) versus 464.5M fully diluted SPCX units. Founder and investor slices below are Dealroom’s public 2026 estimate and are indicative, not a filing. Cursor is now 100% owned by SpaceX; these holders received SPCX Class A or assumed awards.

slices.label: Other named funds (Accel, Coatue, DST, Google, NVIDIA — labels hidden)
